what: A hovered line of text scales to 1.05 in .2s ease, and the small icon attached to the text (speech bubble·tag) pops 15px outward from the text at 1.1 scale, stays for 40~60% of the beat, and returns, repeating on a .9s ease-out beat until the hover ends — in a contents-style Hero where every scattered sentence is a link, this signals ‹click this›. If the icon is above the text it moves up, if left of the text it moves left (look: left), and if at the corner of bent text it moves 10px each to the upper left (look: corner)

options.look: Direction the icon pops out — none: 15px up, left: 15px to the left, corner: 10px·10px to the upper left
options.--fx-hop-x / --fx-hop-y: Bounce distance (via style) — used directly instead of look
options.--fx-grow: Text line size, default 1.05 — at 1 the text stays put and only the icon pops (original at window widths of 1280 and below)
options.--fx-dur / --fx-ease: Duration and curve for line growth, default .2s ease

note: CSS only — icons move with the individual translate and scale properties so the transform used for icon placement isn’t overwritten. Touch devices (no hover) only bounce when focus enters. In the original the icon is a ::before image of the text p, so placement was set separately per sentence — the part takes the icon as a child element
use: Your sentence here
